facts.anchor: Roddie was making dinner when I got home. It was only spaghetti with jarred sauce and a Caesar salad kit that needed to be used up, but I appreciated his initiative. I handed him the garlic
facts.fact: Roddie 下厨（罐装酱意面＋Caesar 沙拉 kit），灵感来自与 Bethany 的通话。

facts.anchor: “Do you want some pop, Roddie?” Mom hovered anxiously, acting like he’d been in the kitchen all day preparing a Thanksgiving turkey with all the trimmings.
facts.fact: 母亲对「他在厨房」反应过度（像在准备感恩节火鸡），并追问 Meg 洗脸与化妆的事。

facts.anchor: “What’s the occasion?” I asked him as I poured myself a glass of wine.
facts.fact: Tyson 把 Bethany 也甩了（为咖啡店认识的人）——Roddie 的判词：Sounds like Tyson doesn't know what he wants.

facts.anchor: “Nothing. I was talking to Bethany, and this is what she was having for dinner. Made me want it too.”
facts.fact: Roddie 透露关键家史：他与父亲互相「像别的爸爸/别的儿子」，各自不按常理长大。

facts.anchor: “You and Bethany are talking? That’s good. Is she still seeing Tyson?”
facts.fact: 母亲宣布「You're perfect exactly as you are」——祖母对孙辈的盖章。

facts.anchor: “Tyson dumped her for someone else. A guy he met in a coffee shop.”
facts.fact: 母亲的住房两难：说再见很难，留下也难；她开始想重新装修，可装修梦被丈夫的病打断。

facts.anchor: “Oof. Sounds like Tyson doesn’t know what he wants.”
facts.fact: Roddie 主动提出回多伦多后跟妈妈住——Meg 心里那枚钩子被扯开。

facts.anchor: “You think?” He used a fork to fish a noodle from the bubbling water.
facts.fact: 章末 Meg 问自己：Georgia 说的对吗？I like having an excuse to see him every day——她承认自己动摇了。
